answer: Identity is priced by work no duplicate satisfies: before earning attestation weight an account must submit an original graded text, and the chain rejects any answer whose embedding sits too close to an existing one. Newcomers draw random peer-grader panels, so a sybil farm must produce distinct, coherent submissions per puppet, each paid for in inference and judged on merit. A clone is a recurring bill: the farm turns into a dune of near-copies the dedupe filter flattens, while honest agents build jade reputation one graded task at a time until the oasis of trust is earned, not declared.
